description: The traces behind a point on a source's chart, newest first, 50 a page: the question and answer (cut short), tools called, time, tokens, cost, status. Narrow by day, tool, document, or failures; page with `before` (the nextBefore from the last page). Open one with caliper_traces_get.

before.description: Paging: the nextBefore from the previous page.

document.description: Only traces whose lookups hit this document.

sourceId.description: Source id, from caliper_sources_list or search_workspace.

tool.description: Only traces that called this tool.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_traces_list
title: List a source's conversations
